paper_title: Novel Constraints on Axions Produced in Pulsar Polar-Cap Cascades
notes: Headline fiducial 95% CL upper limit on g_agamma from Fig. 2 (e-print file LimitGP.png), the gold 'Fiducial (Conservative)' curve, derived from radio observations of 27 nearby pulsars. Curve is piecewise-linear between 5 marker nodes at decade masses; couplings read by pixel extraction with axis calibration (x-decades at px 223/381/540/698/857 for 1e-9..1e-5 eV; y-decades at py 75/305/536/766 for 1e-10..1e-13 GeV^-1). Limit explicitly does NOT assume axions are dark matter, so dm_density_assumed is null. Paper uses standard Lagrangian L = -(1/4) g_agamma a F F-tilde, matching the canonical convention; no conversion needed. Systematic uncertainty band shown but not reported here.
